observations.independent_reading: Independently inspected retained Robert text: the nominal frame and a 2024 tout le monde est le bienvenu occurrence support the welcome-person noun. The feminine greeting and adjective are excluded. This is a retained author capture, not a new reviewer fetch.

Fresh Robert capture separates the literary person/institution service use from dated domestic service; the Europarl use supports public-service devotion. Retain formal register for the selected devoted-person use.

Fresh Robert interjection classification supports the emphatic feeling use. Fixed Wiki particule taxonomy differs from frozen ONO; the selected use fits interjection, not letter-name o or substituted oh.

Independently read the fixed 2018 La ZEP/Le Monde campus account and Ô joie construction. It supplies modern emphatic use in an everyday situation. Retain emphatic register; the full attributed sentence is excluded from selected/supporting content.

Fresh correct Larousse entry /21586 separately labels the title historical and the gallant-young-man sense ironic, with no vieilli label. This permits the ironic interpretation, but a current dictionary listing alone does not establish actual modern everyday use.

Fresh Robert definition is anciennement; playful synonyms do not constitute attestation. Modern-dated examples refer to history, costumes/reenactment or theatrical address; old literary examples do not establish current everyday gallantry. The site says its examples are automatic and not editorially reviewed. Together with fixed Wiki ironique/vieilli, this leaves eligibility unestablished.
